title: Define and validate implementation work manifests
goal: Introduce a strict versioned manifest contract for future implementation epics, lots, sublots and atomic tasks and validate it without breaking legacy E0 bootstrap manifests.
definition_of_done: manifest v2 has a documented machine-readable contract
unknown fields and invalid work-unit types are rejected
allowed and forbidden paths cannot conflict
product references use recognized CMDR identifier families
dependencies and parent identifiers are validated
legacy schema-v1 bootstrap manifests remain readable but are not accepted as future implementation manifests
CI validates every schema-v2 work manifest
